subject: The only way we’ll continue:
body:
Together, we will deliver progress:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1691%2E1086043%2EoyolgC)
Peter, if we’re going to ensure that this is Maryland's decade, we have to be all-in.
That’s why I’m proud that the Maryland Democratic Party is alongside me in this fight. Together, we have delivered enormous progress for the people of Maryland since taking office, but there is still more work to do.
**[Will you power our work to elect Democrats up and down the ballot by splitting a donation between the Maryland Democratic Party and our campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260801-1.XwSU4i&refcode=em-20260801-1&t=2&akid=1691%2E1086043%2EoyolgC)**
Peter, our job is not done -- and we need leaders in every community to help us build on our successes.
In order to continue record drops in violent crime, keep lowering costs for Maryland families, and make our schools even stronger I need a team that will work day and night to build a Maryland that leaves no one behind.
That means running candidates in every race, and challenging Republicans wherever we can, to build the power we need to continue our fight next year and beyond.
**[If you’re with me on that mission, I need your help. Split a donation between our campaign and the Maryland Democratic party today.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260801-1.XwSU4i&refcode=em-20260801-1&t=3&akid=1691%2E1086043%2EoyolgC)**

**FROM: JAY FEELY **
**TO: THE BEST GRASSROOTS ADVISOR IN THE GOP (YOU!)** **SUBJECT: Soon, I’m going to have a heart-to-heart with the President.**
---
|
---
Right after I won my primary, I got my team together, and I asked them to find me SOMEONE who best represents the Grassroots Republican Voter. After looking through hundreds of profiles and reviewing more candidates than I’ve ever done before in my entire life, we finally found someone we could confidently say... **“This is the One”** **[That’s you, friend; you’re THE ONE.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/GJBvAqfi_bs-v4DALHOfw5FxFHWvbCkKyNh97l-9as4VUGil4Jh3EBQ2gvSXsnf-dekkr0rP6MOtKweoUIlA3yZCTsgfUJrmMAcoKYyqRzSX9GUbZtR19FpRfyahafTN1nq6o7fLX7-0i_AchdbOF-efQnGzD66_uwTMuBwFMh72J5Fx-16ttBYIDfPqF9D-Hl-IePdNnTXGZvhr1KMP22f50HzD6n3UY2oeWUthUG4gnDpCK4S_A9BCGdW1BcuRpqrq1uA4Abq4ktvVfveXlZtMd9rc4MURJUoPM-yNZkuSlhW9QUukrfJsiEw2kZM7LWvZHxHiCzNWaW2uaqEyDxZM_ZaicSEbcRmN3Tzq7c_cdvCeZdRAowBu9R9phulvuw6qGFnDhPxndSJnbt_J0bwR1asEzP0WHE-q1OBTW-duEJMV8ZnTVL2DLUwiy6-XVRToppYoaZEfIPsLqDPgbFL1MCgFyGjHOgwIhXlal2adi8i5ayHAHq_MiNXHwwTPFGPpG1XgudfFvPyoMWjoxrxoALH0G3csFwWGjMOE2cxZwPbvPUajTJPTJxL17N7ex3rzyaviX-YrptvwS8suiZpjt8M9bW8Wm2jTC9EQVQ/rEZgolaGbITZ7ndR7kkHO2Qt1mzFDul2/23)** I’m Jay Feely. I recently won my primary here in Arizona, and it’s only a matter of time before I get on the phone with President Trump and we have a heart-to-heart about my election here in Arizona. I just filed my 80th lawsuit against Trump in fewer than 80 weeks since he took office again.
That’s how brazenly and frequently Trump is breaking the law and violating the Constitution.
This latest lawsuit challenges a rule put in place by the Department of Health and Human Services and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services that would push more people onto plans called “catastrophic health insurance plans.” These plans:

→ Aren’t eligible for tax credit
→ And have significantly higher out-of-pocket costs than standard Affordable Care Act plans.
This rule completely (and unlawfully!) undermines the entire point of the ACA: to expand access to affordable healthcare.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. Tomorrow in Milwaukee
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260801-3106)
Live music, special guests and a major canvass launch before the August 11 primary.
Peter,
Tomorrow, I’m joining Congresswoman Ilhan Omar and other VERY special guests for a major rally in South Milwaukee, and I want you there with us.
With just over a week until the August 11 primary, we’re bringing hundreds of supporters together for live music, community action and the launch of a major canvassing push across the Milwaukee area.
**[Space is limited, so RSVP now to claim your spot!](https://act.francescahong.com/go/17192?t=1&akid=3106%2E105371%2EA4xFji)**
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/17192?t=2&akid=3106%2E105371%2EA4xFji)
The event is free and open to the public, but [advance registration is required](https://act.francescahong.com/go/17192?t=3&akid=3106%2E105371%2EA4xFji). The exact location will be sent to registered attendees at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
After the rally, we’ll launch a major canvass to reach Milwaukee-area voters in the final days of the primary.
We’re also collecting supplies for Fox Valley communities recovering from the recent tornadoes. Needed items include:
* Heavy-duty trash bags
* Paper towel and toilet paper
* Flashlights and batteries

We’ll also collect pads and tampons for the Milwaukee Diaper Mission’s Flow Forward period-supply program.
This is one of our last major opportunities to come together before Primary Day. Let’s fill the room, launch this canvass with energy and show Wisconsin the strength of the movement we’ve built.
I hope to see you there!

Hey folks,
I've been saying this for months, and after watching John Fetterman's latest interviews, I don't feel any better about where this is headed. He says he's never leaving the Democratic Party. Then he turns around, goes on conservative media, and attacks Democrats who are trying to win some of the most important Senate races in the country.
At some point, it's fair to ask: what exactly is he trying to accomplish? I dig into all of it in today's episode, and honestly, this one left me more frustrated than ever. If you care about building a Democratic majority that can actually govern, you don't want to miss this conversation.
* **00:01:07** Fetterman claims he only takes issue with the "extremes," but his latest media appearances raise bigger questions about whose arguments he's amplifying.
* **00:03:06** I break down his attacks on Michigan Democrat Abdul El-Sayed and why those comments could hurt Democrats in one of the country's most important Senate races.
* **00:05:22** Why campaigning as a progressive and governing as something completely different has left so many supporters feeling betrayed.
* **00:07:29** I examine the political reality of Fetterman's reelection prospects and why his relationship with Republicans continues to fuel speculation.
* **00:10:06** The bigger picture: why Democrats need a Senate majority that's strong enough to withstand internal defections if they're going to stop Trump's agenda and protect the future of the courts.

This episode is about more than one senator. It's about trust, accountability, and what it takes to build a coalition that's capable of winning elections and governing effectively. I talk about why party unity matters in competitive Senate races, why Democratic voters are paying attention to these fights, and why every seat could determine the future of the Supreme Court, our democracy, and the country itself.

body:
You could say I first learned what It meant to be a conservative while I was out on the ranch.

| |
---
| | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2PnjAQhH-N6YyMzYcbikivkFJcmitSImMvsIo_kHe5y_37iCJKn3KaeeaZn2_rm8OI-fjhEsxItFZakS7InL7oTgkqbTfGgPnw56qVHqWyUnWr84wfsPauCfOgO7vbBuZussOoRmP65pxh28I47aBhH6C3Cqxyg1O660fYlVENzk-fsqrrpn4wut39NuxqCpuFabCdE726r-AYWsyEAciXcl0lIqOnttSjifPJfJEw34RehF4I_F2h_cRcIbS-JKGXrbocSpYHxij3UiXDb0dCL7mAoy929Ev-c7yrP4HqnfMTHXMECUle7gGYpT6AivkQ5sX1BqHHm9PKXpjX9_d3-ddI6NElvgohY8nCvLqmzuH6xBiRxkn06kgO4zOx4f88_mPWfwIAAP__8ZeXMg)
---
Patriot, — I crashed my first tractor the summer after 3rd grade. I spent my summers building churches and running cattle. My high school class had 24 kids in it – We didn't even have enough people to field a football team. It’s Congressman Brandon Gill. You could say I first learned what It meant to be a conservative while I was out on the ranch. When you're building fence out on the ranch you need something to keep your mind going - that's when I started listening to the radio. Rush Limbaugh, Mark Levin, Sean Hannity were on full blast as I drove my tractor, operated the backhoe and built fences. Rush Limbaugh’s voice always seemed to have a way of settling the nervous cattle down. **That's when I first started to think that I wanted to be in politics. I didn't quite know how, but _God had his plan for me._** Those early mornings, those long days, that crackly AM radio — it shaped who I am today. It taught me that America is the greatest place on earth. a land of intrinsic beauty and wonder. It taught me that freedom is worth fighting for as something real and precious that you protect with every fiber of your being. It taught me that God and family are the foundation of everything. So at 29 years old, I decided to run for Congress where I became the youngest House Republican. **[I never imagined that just a few years later, I’d be facing a deadline as massive as this one and sending a final message like this one pleading for your help.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2PnjAQhH-N6YyMzYcbikivkFJcmitSImMvsIo_kHe5y_37iCJKn3KaeeaZn2_rm8OI-fjhEsxItFZakS7InL7oTgkqbTfGgPnw56qVHqWyUnWr84wfsPauCfOgO7vbBuZussOoRmP65pxh28I47aBhH6C3Cqxyg1O660fYlVENzk-fsqrrpn4wut39NuxqCpuFabCdE726r-AYWsyEAciXcl0lIqOnttSjifPJfJEw34RehF4I_F2h_cRcIbS-JKGXrbocSpYHxij3UiXDb0dCL7mAoy929Ev-c7yrP4HqnfMTHXMECUle7gGYpT6AivkQ5sX1BqHHm9PKXpjX9_d3-ddI6NElvgohY8nCvLqmzuH6xBiRxkn06kgO4zOx4f88_mPWfwIAAP__8ZeXMg)** Look, when I first made my decision to go to Washington, I made a promise to myself, to my wife, and to my children. I told them that as long as I live, I will FIGHT to preserve the soul of America. I promised my kids I would fight for their future. Now, more than ever before, the radical left has infected the minds of our next generation with a poisonous hatred for our country. I knew that If I wanted my two children to grow up living in a better American than I did, I had to let my faith in God and my love for my family guide me to fight with everything I had. Democrats are terrified of me because I’ve spent the last year confronting and exposing their insanity for the entire world to see. Right now, they’re mobilizing ahead of the biggest deadline of the year. And as I sit here running through our donor files over and over again, it breaks my heart to tell you this. We’re falling behind and our window is closing FAST. The Left's cash machine is practically printing money, with immense hatred and calls for violence against Trump growing. Meanwhile, our numbers are dead in the water. So If we don’t turn up the heat now, it’s going to be nothing but bad news. Once our deadline hits, that will be all she wrote.

**[Believe me, I’m not someone who finds it easy to ask for support. Emailing you like this is the last thing I thought I’d have to do. But the country we love is on the brink of destruction& I will never stop fighting.](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2PnjAQhH-N6YyMzYcbikivkFJcmitSImMvsIo_kHe5y_37iCJKn3KaeeaZn2_rm8OI-fjhEsxItFZakS7InL7oTgkqbTfGgPnw56qVHqWyUnWr84wfsPauCfOgO7vbBuZussOoRmP65pxh28I47aBhH6C3Cqxyg1O660fYlVENzk-fsqrrpn4wut39NuxqCpuFabCdE726r-AYWsyEAciXcl0lIqOnttSjifPJfJEw34RehF4I_F2h_cRcIbS-JKGXrbocSpYHxij3UiXDb0dCL7mAoy929Ev-c7yrP4HqnfMTHXMECUle7gGYpT6AivkQ5sX1BqHHm9PKXpjX9_d3-ddI6NElvgohY8nCvLqmzuH6xBiRxkn06kgO4zOx4f88_mPWfwIAAP__8ZeXMg)** [**Will you consider chipping in one more time ahead of our critical deadline?**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckD2PnjAQhH-N6YyMzYcbikivkFJcmitSImMvsIo_kHe5y_37iCJKn3KaeeaZn2_rm8OI-fjhEsxItFZakS7InL7oTgkqbTfGgPnw56qVHqWyUnWr84wfsPauCfOgO7vbBuZussOoRmP65pxh28I47aBhH6C3Cqxyg1O660fYlVENzk-fsqrrpn4wut39NuxqCpuFabCdE726r-AYWsyEAciXcl0lIqOnttSjifPJfJEw34RehF4I_F2h_cRcIbS-JKGXrbocSpYHxij3UiXDb0dCL7mAoy929Ev-c7yrP4HqnfMTHXMECUle7gGYpT6AivkQ5sX1BqHHm9PKXpjX9_d3-ddI6NElvgohY8nCvLqmzuH6xBiRxkn06kgO4zOx4f88_mPWfwIAAP__8ZeXMg) For America. **Why do billionaires exist while people starve on the streets of the richest country in history?**
It's not a law of nature -- it's a choice.
The Nordic countries prove it. Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland -- market economies with billionaires and global companies -- where extreme poverty is vanishingly rare.
The difference? They decided healthcare, education, and basic security aren't for sale. They tax wealth seriously and make sure no one falls through the floor.
The result isn't the death of ambition. **It 's the opposite.** People take risks because failure doesn't mean homelessness or medical bankruptcy.
America produces more than enough wealth to care for everyone _and_ leave room for competition and growth. We just chose not to share it.
That's not inevitable. It's a decision -- and decisions can be changed.

body:
August 01, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/27u47rqgx2toh8mloelc3hgrzozrnbgh8kwev/48hvhehm46wwo3txh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2Ivbzh1a2hxaDZxeDg3eGFwMnd3MDI1YXFwejZ6cHFpb2hkZTV6Ng== )

Help Our Email Reach You
------------------------

Sending email to our entire list has become increasingly difficult. Our detractors have made a practice of filing complaints about our weekly messages, and those complaints train the filters — which means frictionless delivery is now nearly impossible. And we expect it to get harder, not easier. The most reliable fix is on your end: please whitelist our name. It takes less than a minute, and it works in every email program, old or new. Here's how to do it:

* Open your email program and find a message from True the Vote — check your Spam, Junk, or Promotions folder if you don't see one in your inbox.
* If it's in Spam or Junk, click Not Spam (or Not Junk), then move the message to your inbox.
* Open one of our emails and add the sender address — catherinee@truethevote.org ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/27u47rqgx2toh8mloelc3hgrzozrnbgh8kwev/wnh2hghqexmmzza7hx/bWFpbHRvOmNhdGhlcmluZWVAdHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3Jn ) — to your contacts or address book. In most programs you can right-click the sender's name and choose Add to Contacts.
* To seal the deal, reply to this email with a quick "hello" — even one word. Nothing signals "this sender is welcome" more strongly than a reply.

That's it. This same four-step habit works for True the Vote or any sender you don't want to miss — your bank, your doctor, your church. Thank you for taking a moment to keep our line open. We'll keep doing our part with our email provider, and together we'll stay connected.

From Catherine
--------------

Hi Friend —

Gallup just released the results of its nationwide poll of Americans' views on elections, and the numbers came back about how you'd expect (see below). Two-thirds of Americans are concerned that political leaders will pressure election officials to change an outcome. Nearly 6 in 10 worry ballots won't be handled or counted properly. Among Republicans, 78% are concerned about ineligible ballots being cast. We were called conspiracy theorists for saying these things out loud. Now most of the country is saying it with us.

An Example of the Crazy Making: Alaska walked into a no-win situation this week, and it's a great example of a baseline problem every state faces. Checking its voter roll against DMV records, Alaska flagged 3,048 voters as possible noncitizens and moved them to the inactive list. They can still vote, just not normally. They'll cast a questioned ballot — Alaska's version of a provisional — reviewed after Election Day and counted only if the state clears them. But an unknown number of the 3,048 are lawful voters, including several who have already proven it.

Here's the bind. Leave questionable names on the roll and you risk ineligible ballots canceling out lawful ones. Pull them and you risk removing lawful voters through a process that is nowhere near foolproof. Alaska chose removal, three weeks out from a primary, and still can't say how many of the 3,048 are actually ineligible. The elections director blames old DMV data. The DMV says Elections asked for it and got back current status. Neither has answered the question.

Now step back. This is a state where a hunting license satisfies the ID requirement at the polls, while a database match was enough to deactivate 3,048 registrations. Broken process on both ends.

Our recommendation is an overhaul, end to end. Better data, better safeguards, better answers when it goes wrong. America, we have to do better.

In other news, California rejected nearly 150,000 mail ballots in their recent primary. Fulton County, GA is back in the headlines. And newly declassified files continue to be released to the White House election integrity page ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/27u47rqgx2toh8mloelc3hgrzozrnbgh8kwev/reh8hohmgwk499s2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2hpdGVob3VzZS5nb3YvZWxlY3Rpb24taW50ZWdyaXR5Lw== ).

None of this gets fixed from the top down. In the Alaska situation, twenty-three Alaska legislators wrote that a letter to the state, demanding answers, because Alaskans checked their own registrations, found the problem, and made noise about it. That is the entire mechanism. It has never been anything else.

So here's the ask. Join us on True the Vote NOW ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/27u47rqgx2toh8mloelc3hgrzozrnbgh8kwev/08hwh9h23gnv0oilh5/aHR0cHM6Ly9jb21tdW5pdHkudHR2bm93Lm9yZy9jaGVja291dC9iZWNvbWUtYS1tZW1iZXI= )and find the people already working in your state. Then pick one thing — your rolls, your ID standards, pick any illogical process — and don't let go of it until it's solved. Look at how other industries handle these things. Banks reconcile their accounts every single day. Hospitals track chain of custody on every vial of blood. FedEx scans a package at every handoff. None of it is exotic, and none of it is beyond us. Call your legislators, and call them again. Show up to the public meetings nobody attends. Say the hard thing out loud when the room would rather you didn't.

Government will not fix itself. It never has. It gets fixed by citizens who refuse to go away. Like you. Like me.

We cannot stop.

Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW!

Ever onward —

-->Stand With True the Vote ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/27u47rqgx2toh8mloelc3hgrzozrnbgh8kwev/8ghqhohomqwze2bkh9/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
Stand With True the Vote ( truethevote.org/donate )We can't do this without you — and we wouldn't want to.

Thank you for your support!

Great work—and we have a hunch there's more to come.

True the Vote will keep doing our part. With faith as our foundation and patriots like you standing in the gap, we'll keep pressing for transparency, accountability, and an America we leave stronger than we found it.

Ever onward.

Thank you for your support!

Father, Thank You for giving us the unchanging truth of Your Word in a world filled with constantly changing opinions and messages. When the world tells us to follow our hearts, teach us to follow You. When the world labels us by our past, remind us that we are new creations in Christ. When the world tells us to live only for today, help us to number our days and invest in eternity. And when the world encourages us to follow our feelings, graciously give us the wisdom and courage to follow Your Word instead.

Strengthen our discernment so that we will faithfully test every message we hear against Your Word. Help us take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ. Teach us to recognize truth from error, wisdom from deception, and Your voice above every other voice competing for our attention. Give us hearts that continually seek You and lives that are built upon Your firm foundation.

Thank You that Your truth never changes because Your character never changes. May our thoughts, our words, our decisions, and our lives increasingly reflect Jesus so that others may see You and give You glory.

In Jesus' Name, Amen.

clean_body: August 01, 2026 | Read Online ( == ) Help Our Email Reach You Sending email to our entire list has become increasingly difficult. Our detractors have made a practice of filing complaints about our weekly messages, and those complaints train the filters — which means frictionless delivery is now nearly impossible. And we expect it to get harder, not easier. The most reliable fix is on your end: please whitelist our name. It takes less than a minute, and it works in every email program, old or new. Here's how to do it: Open your email program and find a message from True the Vote — check your Spam, Junk, or Promotions folder if you don't see one in your inbox. If it's in Spam or Junk, click Not Spam (or Not Junk), then move the message to your inbox. Open one of our emails and add the sender address — catherinee@truethevote.org ( ) — to your contacts or address book. In most programs you can right-click the sender's name and choose Add to Contacts. To seal the deal, reply to this email with a quick "hello" — even one word. Nothing signals "this sender is welcome" more strongly than a reply. That's it. This same four-step habit works for True the Vote or any sender you don't want to miss — your bank, your doctor, your church. Thank you for taking a moment to keep our line open. We'll keep doing our part with our email provider, and together we'll stay connected. From Catherine Hi Friend — Gallup just released the results of its nationwide poll of Americans' views on elections, and the numbers came back about how you'd expect (see below). Two-thirds of Americans are concerned that political leaders will pressure election officials to change an outcome. Nearly 6 in 10 worry ballots won't be handled or counted properly. Among Republicans, 78% are concerned about ineligible ballots being cast. We were called conspiracy theorists for saying these things out loud. Now most of the country is saying it with us. An Example of the Crazy Making: Alaska walked into a no-win situation this week, and it's a great example of a baseline problem every state faces. Checking its voter roll against DMV records, Alaska flagged 3,048 voters as possible noncitizens and moved them to the inactive list. They can still vote, just not normally. They'll cast a questioned ballot — Alaska's version of a provisional — reviewed after Election Day and counted only if the state clears them. But an unknown number of the 3,048 are lawful voters, including several who have already proven it. Here's the bind. Leave questionable names on the roll and you risk ineligible ballots canceling out lawful ones. Pull them and you risk removing lawful voters through a process that is nowhere near foolproof. Alaska chose removal, three weeks out from a primary, and still can't say how many of the 3,048 are actually ineligible. The elections director blames old DMV data. The DMV says Elections asked for it and got back current status. Neither has answered the question. Now step back. This is a state where a hunting license satisfies the ID requirement at the polls, while a database match was enough to deactivate 3,048 registrations. Broken process on both ends. Our recommendation is an overhaul, end to end. Better data, better safeguards, better answers when it goes wrong. America, we have to do better. Banks reconcile their accounts every single day. Hospitals track chain of custody on every vial of blood. FedEx scans a package at every handoff. None of it is exotic, and none of it is beyond us. Call your legislators, and call them again. Show up to the public meetings nobody attends. Say the hard thing out loud when the room would rather you didn't. Government will not fix itself. A month on the ground. Here is what we saw.

| | | | |
---
Hey y’all,
July was a month worth remembering, and I am excited to share a few of the highlights.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/XzZoTmW2OqbE5MY1uX_Gvg~~/AAUS1hA~/X_elUrm_1hjFRo0teVPOvI0Kkucehnbacj849U1cQQ4tkhwpYhBVvl_xLlQvL-c-pUt0iXwNk7wtrZC09AqfcRvS9JxzAWTQkdDGjjSohjKPBdvXCz8FCUBOmuNIo0LhKd1Vdpri2DxuyaFpMxQA2LitKAiX9Ou8o5Gzvo9--WgQaM03jTNqSsnfxePu2Inkduzgmb-TWdNPM8ohYgIlcrhQrrG8hTRNF0Cy9ebvvLllVAdXFwd1u20dvE4GqJikpckE3nIH5_lnbiZziZWFNA~~)
The energy at our Meet and Greet at Campaign HQ in Franklin reminded us of what is important in this campaign — being available to voters, talking about issues that matter, and showing that this campaign is built to last.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/bVBH0U1w95hwdHzmBmsxMw~~/AAUS1hA~/X_elUrm_1hjFRo0teVPOvI0Kkucehnbacj849U1cQQ4tkhwpYhBVvl_xLlQvL-c-pUt0iXwNk7wtrZC09AqfcRvS9JxzAWTQkdDGjjSohjKPBdvXCz8FCUBOmuNIo0LhKd1Vdpri2DxuyaFpMxQA2LitKAiX9Ou8o5Gzvo9--WgQaM03jTNqSsnfxePu2InkZPqZhdLXaydc1CMBe8FeOLw9GD3WWr30iZO1iB3hZ5Yg8tfnYbaNzJC4f_gWZ-Ej2iruBv__3Ui1n6h9tzBZnQ~~)
We went back home to Maury County and Columbia to go door-to-door canvassing. This campaign started in Maury County. It’s where I was born and raised. Even though the lines split Maury County into two separate districts, I will always champion my hometown, no matter the lines!
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/7CPR4M13ciGhOKBlDR4y7Q~~/AAUS1hA~/X_elUrm_1hjFRo0teVPOvI0Kkucehnbacj849U1cQQ4tkhwpYhBVvl_xLlQvL-c-pUt0iXwNk7wtrZC09AqfcRvS9JxzAWTQkdDGjjSohjKPBdvXCz8FCUBOmuNIo0LhKd1Vdpri2DxuyaFpMxQA2LitKAiX9Ou8o5Gzvo9--WgQaM03jTNqSsnfxePu2InksqPEJhQMWx5LqCkLS7IxxpZhC7uI0vEYOYz5orF8SwRHTCGgk3iytd9NAX5srWf59RcXdY9xIsIBxmXVTUCxXQ~~)
We hit early voting locations across Memphis, talking to voters and making sure every person who walks through those doors knows there is a champion on the ballot for TN-5. Memphis deserves nothing less.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/__7QIXzh86BKQTVbpDOxTA~~/AAUS1hA~/X_elUrm_1hjFRo0teVPOvI0Kkucehnbacj849U1cQQ4tkhwpYhBVvl_xLlQvL-c-pUt0iXwNk7wtrZC09AqfcRvS9JxzAWTQkdDGjjSohjKPBdvXCz8FCUBOmuNIo0LhKd1Vdpri2DxuyaFpMxQA2LitKAiX9Ou8o5Gzvo9--WgQaM03jTNqSsnfxePu2InkCAaM8Sia9qWZ6orXuC73FhecB6QISNEmVt6zc3nf8L0CoOmx-BfJb4E-nLMIhVcHEI_WsubwF9PkdjTbwPkZiQ~~)
Sunday lunch at the Four Way in Memphis. Soul food, history, fellowship, and a reminder of exactly why this race matters — the people.
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/NlTZju3UiqcEsuCfzsyMNQ~~/AAUS1hA~/X_elUrm_1hjFRo0teVPOvI0Kkucehnbacj849U1cQQ4tkhwpYhBVvl_xLlQvL-c-pUt0iXwNk7wtrZC09AqfcRvS9JxzAWTQkdDGjjSohjKPBdvXCz8FCUBOmuNIo0LhKd1Vdpri2DxuyaFpMxQA2LitKAiX9Ou8o5Gzvo9--WgQaM03jTNqSsnfxePu2InkQ2VT1I0avS5tDEIMTbfIWRiBAOgr7O-KLFHxc4zQIGgJuCDA4IhHaX4eqfrdkjipOPkqCcpGDaNF5G63DFDK7Q~~)
We canvassed Memphis neighborhoods alongside our volunteers, talking to farmers, families, and neighbors who are ready for change in Washington. And for a Congressman who will make them proud.
July proved what we already knew: this campaign has the legs to win. August 6th is days away, and we need your help to close it out.

Happy Saturday, Peter!
We're in the final 10 DAYS of this Primary Election. The finish line is in sight, and every conversation, every vote, and every hour of your time between now and August 11th matters.
Here are three ways you can help build our momentum TODAY :
1. 🗳️ VOTE — AND MAKE YOUR PLAN
TODAY is the last day to MAIL your absentee ballot back.
The City of Burlington recommends [https://www.burlingtonvt.gov/Elections] mailing your absentee ballot no later than August 1st. After today, don’t put your ballot in the mail — return it to your town hall or a ballot drop box [https://www.vpirg.org/vermont-ballot-drop-box-lookup/] instead.
Haven’t made your voting plan yet? Do it today. Pick a time, make a plan, and make sure your friends and family have one, too. Ten days go by fast!
2. 📱 JOIN TEAM MOLLY ON THE PHONES
Want to help us win this thing from your couch? We need you to help reach voters across Vermont. Sign up to phone bank [https://forms.gle/PALvTZEp3oPYR1wz7] with Team Molly and help us have the conversations that will get people to the polls on August 11th.
Sign up here>> https://forms.gle/PALvTZEp3oPYR1wz7 [https://forms.gle/PALvTZEp3oPYR1wz7]
3. 🎉 JOIN OUR GOTV RALLY — TUESDAY AT 7 PM
We’re bringing the whole team together for a virtual Get Out The Vote Rally this Tuesday at 7 PM! RSVP HERE>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotvmgzoom [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotvmgzoom]
We’ll be joined by special guests Mirna Valerio, Rep. Jonathan Cooper, and more as we kick off the final stretch to Election Day. We’re kicking off the final sprint together — and you’re invited.
We have 10 days. Let’s make every single one count.
The momentum is real. The coalition is growing. And together, we’re going to finish this strong.
Let’s go!

In geometry, a straight line is the shortest distance between two points. In politics, it is a crayon scribble drawn by a caffeinated toddler connecting dots that refuse to sit still. Just look at a gerrymander map to see. Can we draw a direct line from Senator Joseph McCarthy's communist-hunting fever dreams, to California allegedly banning communism, to the Communist Party USA (CPUSA), to today's Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) supposedly piloting the Democratic Party like Bernie Sanders is its admiral? Using only verifiable content, this line is about to get very wobbly...

_Funeral prayers for JAAC leader Sardar Umar Nazir 's brother Usman Nazir, led by their brother Siddique Nazir. Photo from the Facebook page of Hamza Naseer._
Early on the morning of July 9, 2026, men from a paramilitary force known as the Pakistan Rangers began raiding homes in the village of Gehl Topi, a few kilometers from the city of Rawalakot in Pakistan-administered Kashmir--known locally as Azad Kashmir.
It was four weeks after protests over electoral reform erupted in Azad Kashmir, and a curfew was in place. The local mosque announced over its loudspeaker that the Rangers, who operate under military authority, had entered the village, and a crowd began gathering.
The armed men opened fire on the crowd, according to one eyewitness and another person who has family members in the village. Hassan Zohaib, who was present at the scene, said his cousin, Muhammad Nasir Khan, 39, was killed. Khan, a night caretaker at a government-run school, who had walked downhill along the Link Road to see why people were gathering. When the Rangers opened fire, a bullet entered Khan's side, tore through his rib cage, and exited his neck. "We rushed him to the Rural Health Center in Chitra Topi, but there were no doctors or paramedical staff, and the blood loss was too severe. He could not survive," his cousin, Hassan Zohaib, told Drop Site News.
Khan has four children; the eldest is ten. The same day, Zohaib's family buried a second relative killed by military gunfire in the same village, a 22-year-old named Wajid Siddique. "I am not sure what kind of ammunition they are using, because he was shot in his lower abdomen, which was blown away, and he died instantly," Zohaib said. "We could not even take him to the hospital."
Neither Siddique's nor Khan's death has been reported in the local press, which is subject to intense censorship and has not been allowed to report on the violent crackdown in Kashmir. For eight weeks now the demonstrations in Rawalakot--a city just 40 kilometers away from the disputed Line of Control with India that has become an epicenter of the movement--have been met with live-fire by Pakistani security forces, mass arrests, and a siege of the city.

Locals who spoke to Drop Site said that number is a significant undercount.
Despite the violent crackdown, civilians have continued to demonstrate against local authorities and the Pakistani military. In a video circulating on social media this week, a travel vlogger identified as Aqeel says to the camera, "The streets of Rawalakot are drenched in blood. They are shooting our brothers with the bullets they purchase with our taxpayer money," as gunshots are audible in the background.

Harris Qadeer, editor of the local newspaper Roznama Jeddojehad _,_ told Drop Site that he has [documented](https://substack.com/redirect/38403f78-8075-4cd2-b49d-c05c1d787392?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 89 deaths in Rawalakot and Mirpur as of July 28 by collecting first-hand accounts of funerals, burials, and death records maintained by a civil society group that has been leading the protests.
"Forty-five people were killed before July 27, and a list of their names was compiled by consulting their family members. An additional 37 people were killed on July 27 and 28," he said. On Monday, Qadeer added, paramilitary forces killed 22 more civilians, as well as another 13 the next day.
The region has remained under curfew and a complete internet blackout since June 5, 2026. No food or medicine has entered and grocery store owners are not allowed to open for business. Regular announcements from loudspeakers of local mosques declare that any civilian violating curfew, including women and children, will be shot without hesitation.
"Armed officers torture anyone who attempts to open for business and a majority of the rations present inside the stores were confiscated by the officers for their own use," Qadeer said. Local residents of Rawalakot are only able to bring negligible amounts of food and groceries from their relatives in nearby villages.
"Patients can still not access any medicines and those who could afford to move had to move to Rawalpindi and Islamabad where they are forced to live in hotels," he added.
## **Escalating Repression**
Protests in Azad Kashmir began in early June over electricity tariffs, wheat prices, and accusations of bribery and corruption by local government officials, led by the Jammu Kashmir Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC). JAAC, a coalition of local traders, civil society members, and political activists, has been organizing demonstrations in Kashmir for the past three years.
But the core demand from the protesters centers around the allocation of 12 reserved seats in the local assembly for Indian Kashmiri refugees living in Pakistan, which the authorities accepted in September 2025, but backed out as the region approached election day. Within a few weeks, the protests evolved into a Kashmir-wide call for electoral reforms.
The 12 seats sought by locals are reserved for refugees who left Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir for Pakistan after the partition of the subcontinent in 1947, which also includes their descendants. These people settled in various parts of the country and are now registered to vote in Pakistan's four other provinces rather than in Pakistani administered Kashmir.
Civil society activists including the JAAC argue that this system takes local governance issues out of the hands of those actually living in Azad Kashmir. Those eligible to run on these seats are not residents of Kashmir and, JAAC argues, therefore do not represent the concerns of locals. Pakistan's military establishment and the central government have historically used these seats to sway votes in favor of policies that go against the interest of Kashmiris.
JAAC circulated a charter of demands with 38 points that formed the bedrock of negotiations between the chief organizers of the protest movement and the Chairman of the Overseas Pakistanis Forum (OPF), Syed Qamar Raza Shah, who is believed to maintain a close relationship with Pakistan's military chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir.
The group is demanding reforms to the system of of assembly seats, elimination of bribery and corruption in government departments, provision of interest-free loans for the youth, elimination of false charges against protesting civilians, and medical treatment for protesters injured by armed forces among others.
In a recent video statement published on JAAC leader Sardar Umar Nazir's Facebook [page](https://substack.com/redirect/f2e496a1-e5a8-4fe3-948d-a968091a26e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), he reiterated the demand for electoral reforms. "This election that's ongoing right now is being carried out at gunpoint," he said. "We will not create obstacles for this election but we, as JAAC, declare these fraudulent and farcical." He further invited all residents of Muzaffarabad to reject the elections and continue protesting on the streets of Kashmir.
Pakistan's military junta has shown little tolerance for the protests. The JAAC was designated as a terrorist organization by the government in June. Since then the Pakistan Rangers, along with other security forces working under the Pakistani Army and officials working for the district administration, have been [carrying out](https://substack.com/redirect/39818c08-b38f-4e4f-a70c-9678e689c0d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) regular "flag marches"--sending processions of 20 to 25 vehicles carrying masked men, mounted with machine guns, through villages around Rawalakot with sirens blaring.
"They've spread so much fear and intimidation into the hearts of the residents in that region, to a common village man it is an unbelievable sight," said Zohaib. "As soon as ten or more people gather just to see what's going on, they open fire at them."
On June 4, a trader was shot during a confrontation with law enforcement officers. The next day, family members took the body to Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Rawalakot for a post-mortem examination. The request for an examination was denied, enraging locals who began gathering outside the hospital.
On June 5, the AJK government issued a notification declaring JAAC a proscribed organization under the First Schedule of the Anti-Terrorism Act 2014, citing "terrorism" and conduct "prejudicial to peace and security," listing 147 members of the civil society group as a members of a terrorist organization.
Then, late on the night of June 6, JAAC organizers returned to Rawalakot from a meeting in Khaigla, eight kilometers from the city. Unidentified men opened fire, killing Shahzaib Habib, an activist who worked closely with the JAAC leadership.
The following night, clashes broke out in Rawalakot between supporters of JAAC and the police, resulting in the deaths of seven civilians and three police officers, according to the police commissioner of Poonch, Sardar Waheed.
The local government then imposed a legal measure banning all public gatherings and suspending cellular service across the region. That measure has remained largely in place since.
"Three people were killed in my village on the same day, there is no access to the internet and barely any access to cellular services. It is impossible to tell how many people have been shot dead by the paramilitary forces so far," said Zohaib.
Several government employees have been fired, and pensions have been seized for several retired military officers who were accused of participating in the protests.
On July 9, JAAC called for a region-wide strike to close markets, businesses, educational institutions and public transport. Protesters established a sit-in at Drek, a suburb on the outskirts of Rawalakot, among six other protest venues, while Pakistan Rangers and Frontier Constabulary (FC) forces were deployed en masse. More than 45 civilians were killed in the violent crackdown that followed.
On July 27, as Mirpur division voted, the JAAC marched into Rawalakot city, defying the region-wide curfew. The two days that followed were the deadliest in terms of civilian casualties. Members of the FC and the Rangers situated themselves on rooftops to try to quash any protests in the street. Reports emerged that security forces had shot civilians indiscriminately, including those who had no part in the protest.
Shehreyar Zulfiqar, born and raised in Rawalakot, moved to Lahore in 2018 and regularly visits his family. He now speaks to his mother by phone every three days, on a line that has become increasingly unreliable. His family lives within a 100 meter distance from the hospital and has witnessed much of the repression up close. His neighbor Farrukh Aziz, who ran a grocery store, was shot dead on July 27.

---|---|---
Right to left: Farrukh Aziz, shopkeeper; Abdul Aziz (father of Uzair Aziz); Uzair Aziz (PAF squadron leader); Osama Jameel (PhD student).
"He was not a part of the march, he had nothing to do with the political atmosphere in the city. He was only grabbing groceries from his own store for his family members," Zulfiqar told Drop Site News. "Snipers killed him with a headshot, they were perched atop a nearby building and they killed him when he was on his way back home."
Usman Nazir, the brother of JAAC leader Umar Nazir, was also killed on July 27 when the Rangers opened fire on protesters in Rawalakot.
In the same neighborhood, an officer of the Pakistan Air Force (PAF), squadron leader Uzair Aziz, lives with his family.
His father Abdul Aziz, who was a school teacher at a local high school, and his brother were also shot by armed officers in the streets of Rawalalot as the two were on their way back home. "His father passed away and his brother is severely injured," said Zulfiqar. "They have not even returned his father's dead body to their family. And this is not even a civilian, this man leads a squadron in the air force." Aziz's family, Zuliqar added, were not involved in the protests; his family has lived in Rawalakot for four generations.
In one of the many videos from the scenes of protest on the ground, a young student is seen reciting Sarfaroshi Ki Tamanna, an Urdu poem written by Bismil Azimabadi, which roughly translates to "The desire to sacrifice our lives is now in our hearts; let us see how much strength is in the arms of our executioner."

That student was Osama Jameel, a geology PhD scholar at Quaid-i-Azam University in Islamabad, and a member of the Jammu Kashmir National Students Federation (JKNSF), a group that has been aligned with the JAAC for the better part of a decade. On July 28, he was gunned down at Chinar Chowk, while marching towards Muzaffarabad.
Omer Khan, a member of the JKNSF was privy to the negotiations between the government and JAAC from a year ago. "They had signed an agreement and accepted the demands, including the one about 12 assembly seats after eight civilians were killed in September 2025," he said. "When elections came closer, they backed out of every promise they made because they [the military establishment] have been using these seats to install their own leadership in the Kashmir assembly, overturning the democratic choice of the people of Kashmir."
## **" They Have Subjected Us to Collective Punishment"**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a889cad2-dfb3-4366-b580-17ffcd803881?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Thousands of residents gathered in Drek, Rawalakot on July 23, 2026. Photo from the Facebook page of Hamza Naseer._
Pakistan's Defense Minister Khwaja Asif has labeled the protesters as enemies of the state and ruled out any possibility of future negotiations with the JAAC. On Tuesday, Asif told reporters, "There will be no dialogue with the protesters. I bracket them with India. I put them in the same category as India and consider them as enemies of Pakistan."
The crackdown has triggered a major backlash in the Kashmiri diaspora, including in London where more than 1.5 million Kashmiris from Pakistan live and where thousands gathered in a massive demonstration against the violence this month.
JAAC activists on the ground are now planning to conduct a march to enter Rawalkot on Saturday in defiance of the siege, before continuing in a planned procession onwards to Muzaffarabad, the capital of Azad Kashmir.
Qadeer, the local journalist in Azad Kashmir, was forced to relocate his family members to the city of Rawalpindi in Punjab. He told Drop Site that the situation has become unbearable for journalists and activists still attempting to document conditions inside the province.
"No journalist is allowed to move, in fact no journalist is acknowledged as a member of the press even if they have a card identifying them as such. Everyone with video recordings in their phones are forced to delete them," Qadeer explained. "They torture everyone attempting any journalistic activity. They have beat me up in public as well."
He added, "They are punishing us all indiscriminately, they are subjecting us to collective punishment and they want to make an example out of us. They are using battle-grade weapons, the violence is senseless."

He further invited all residents of Muzaffarabad to reject the elections and continue protesting on the streets of Kashmir. Pakistan's military junta has shown little tolerance for the protests. The JAAC was designated as a terrorist organization by the government in June. Since then the Pakistan Rangers, along with other security forces working under the Pakistani Army and officials working for the district administration, have been regular "flag marches"--sending processions of 20 to 25 vehicles carrying masked men, mounted with machine guns, through villages around Rawalakot with sirens blaring. "They've spread so much fear and intimidation into the hearts of the residents in that region, to a common village man it is an unbelievable sight," said Zohaib. "As soon as ten or more people gather just to see what's going on, they open fire at them." On June 4, a trader was shot during a confrontation with law enforcement officers. The next day, family members took the body to Combined Military Hospital (CMH) in Rawalakot for a post-mortem examination. The request for an examination was denied, enraging locals who began gathering outside the hospital. On June 5, the AJK government issued a notification declaring JAAC a proscribed organization under the First Schedule of the Anti-Terrorism Act 2014, citing "terrorism" and conduct "prejudicial to peace and security," listing 147 members of the civil society group as a members of a terrorist organization. Then, late on the night of June 6, JAAC organizers returned to Rawalakot from a meeting in Khaigla, eight kilometers from the city. Unidentified men opened fire, killing Shahzaib Habib, an activist who worked closely with the JAAC leadership. The following night, clashes broke out in Rawalakot between supporters of JAAC and the police, resulting in the deaths of seven civilians and three police officers, according to the police commissioner of Poonch, Sardar Waheed. The local government then imposed a legal measure banning all public gatherings and suspending cellular service across the region. That measure has remained largely in place since. "Three people were killed in my village on the same day, there is no access to the internet and barely any access to cellular services. It is impossible to tell how many people have been shot dead by the paramilitary forces so far," said Zohaib. Several government employees have been fired, and pensions have been seized for several retired military officers who were accused of participating in the protests. On July 9, JAAC called for a region-wide strike to close markets, businesses, educational institutions and public transport. Protesters established a sit-in at Drek, a suburb on the outskirts of Rawalakot, among six other protest venues, while Pakistan Rangers and Frontier Constabulary (FC) forces were deployed en masse. More than 45 civilians were killed in the violent crackdown that followed. On July 27, as Mirpur division voted, the JAAC marched into Rawalakot city, defying the region-wide curfew. The two days that followed were the deadliest in terms of civilian casualties. Members of the FC and the Rangers situated themselves on rooftops to try to quash any protests in the street. Reports emerged that security forces had shot civilians indiscriminately, including those who had no part in the protest. Shehreyar Zulfiqar, born and raised in Rawalakot, moved to Lahore in 2018 and regularly visits his family. He now speaks to his mother by phone every three days, on a line that has become increasingly unreliable. His family lives within a 100 meter distance from the hospital and has witnessed much of the repression up close. His neighbor Farrukh Aziz, who ran a grocery store, was shot dead on July 27. | | ---|---|--- Right to left: Farrukh Aziz, shopkeeper; Abdul Aziz (father of Uzair Aziz); Uzair Aziz (PAF squadron leader); Osama Jameel (PhD student). "He was not a part of the march, he had nothing to do with the political atmosphere in the city. He was only grabbing groceries from his own store for his family members," Zulfiqar told Drop Site News. "Snipers killed him with a headshot, they were perched atop a nearby building and they killed him when he was on his way back home." Usman Nazir, the brother of JAAC leader Umar Nazir, was also killed on July 27 when the Rangers opened fire on protesters in Rawalakot. In the same neighborhood, an officer of the Pakistan Air Force (PAF), squadron leader Uzair Aziz, lives with his family. His father Abdul Aziz, who was a school teacher at a local high school, and his brother were also shot by armed officers in the streets of Rawalalot as the two were on their way back home. "His father passed away and his brother is severely injured," said Zulfiqar. "They have not even returned his father's dead body to their family. And this is not even a civilian, this man leads a squadron in the air force." Aziz's family, Zuliqar added, were not involved in the protests; his family has lived in Rawalakot for four generations. In one of the many videos from the scenes of protest on the ground, a young student is seen reciting Sarfaroshi Ki Tamanna, an Urdu poem written by Bismil Azimabadi, which roughly translates to "The desire to sacrifice our lives is now in our hearts; let us see how much strength is in the arms of our executioner." Instagram That student was Osama Jameel, a geology PhD scholar at Quaid-i-Azam University in Islamabad, and a member of the Jammu Kashmir National Students Federation (JKNSF), a group that has been aligned with the JAAC for the better part of a decade. On July 28, he was gunned down at Chinar Chowk, while marching towards Muzaffarabad. Omer Khan, a member of the JKNSF was privy to the negotiations between the government and JAAC from a year ago. "They had signed an agreement and accepted the demands, including the one about 12 assembly seats after eight civilians were killed in September 2025," he said. "When elections came closer, they backed out of every promise they made because they [the military establishment] have been using these seats to install their own leadership in the Kashmir assembly, overturning the democratic choice of the people of Kashmir." " They Have Subjected Us to Collective Punishment" | | ---|---|--- Thousands of residents gathered in Drek, Rawalakot on July 23, 2026. Photo from the Facebook page of Hamza Naseer. Pakistan's Defense Minister Khwaja Asif has labeled the protesters as enemies of the state and ruled out any possibility of future negotiations with the JAAC. On Tuesday, Asif told reporters, "There will be no dialogue with the protesters. I bracket them with India. I put them in the same category as India and consider them as enemies of Pakistan." The crackdown has triggered a major backlash in the Kashmiri diaspora, including in London where more than 1.5 million Kashmiris from Pakistan live and where thousands gathered in a massive demonstration against the violence this month. JAAC activists on the ground are now planning to conduct a march to enter Rawalkot on Saturday in defiance of the siege, before continuing in a planned procession onwards to Muzaffarabad, the capital of Azad Kashmir. Qadeer, the local journalist in Azad Kashmir, was forced to relocate his family members to the city of Rawalpindi in Punjab. He told Drop Site that the situation has become unbearable for journalists and activists still attempting to document conditions inside the province. "No journalist is allowed to move, in fact no journalist is acknowledged as a member of the press even if they have a card identifying them as such. Everyone with video recordings in their phones are forced to delete them," Qadeer explained. "They torture everyone attempting any journalistic activity. They have beat me up in public as well." He added, "They are punishing us all indiscriminately, they are subjecting us to collective punishment and they want to make an example out of us. They are using battle-grade weapons, the violence is senseless." | A guest post by| journalist, fact checker, researcher, and socialist feminist. I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash.
We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet.
My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly.
“Take the pay cut or go home,” they were told.
I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family.
I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too.
And it’s that fight I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians.
Now’s our chance to change that. NAME, we have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families.
So that’s why I have to ask: Can you chip in a donation of any amount split between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to defeat Collins and take back our Democratic majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]
DONATE TO DEFEAT SUSAN COLLINS AND FLIP THE SENATE! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jackson]
I appreciate your support always,
Troy

August 1, 2026

Most readers know Dr. Anthony Fauci as the architect of restrictions placed on the country during the COVID epidemic. But many do not realize that as a young medical bureaucrat, he promulgated the "4H" risk factors of the AIDS epidemic of the 1980s - "Homosexuals, Heroin Addicts, Hemophiliacs and Haitians."
Here is a young Dr. Fauci presented stating Haitians are a risk group for AIDS.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/3835aa0b-980e-4119-98df-a2fbd0c85c47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Now Dr. Fauci is a medical doctor. To name Haitians as a risk group for AIDS was pure nonsense. There is no biological reason that Haitians were at a higher risk for AIDS. Dr. Fauci certainly knew this. So why did he do this?

Politics.

As one Haitian physician, Dr. Ary Bordes stated: "Who better to blame for AIDS than a poor black nation whose populace did not speak English?"

I was a volunteer physician in Haiti in 1984 and treated numerous AIDS patients and it was obvious to me along with my Haitian physician colleagues why AIDS was present. It was brought to Haiti by gay American tourists seeking what they termed "Nubian delights." The vast majority of patients I treated for AIDS were homosexual prostitutes. And they all died.

Dr. Fauci undoubtably knew this. Anyone with half a brain knew this. So why blame Haiti? Because Dr. Fauci knew that if he spoke the truth, he would have been bashed by the increasingly powerful gay rights movement who did wish to have their reprehensible behavior publicized. Gays were much more politically powerful than Haitians.

Fast forward to the COVID epidemic. Dr. Fauci's once jet black hair is now gray, but he is still a political animal. And he kept diaries - over 1000 pages of them that thanks to Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky - who is also a physician, are now public knowledge.

And the Fauci's entries reveal a man who enjoyed media flattery and celebrity status, but with little interest in objective data regarding COVID. One telling entry states: "POTUS [Donald Trump] seems to be enamored of me."

Other entries include:
"All my friends keep saying I am a national hero."
"Donuts are being named after me; T shirts have my picture on them."
"I did all 5 Sunday Shows"
But at some point, Fauci realized that he could be instrumental in defeating Trump, and that is when he became a media darling. But President Trump was suckered into listening to Fauci's recommendations anyway. Thus, schools were closed, businesses shut down, and the economy collapsed. Meanwhile, President Trump printed trillions to subsidize businesses greatly increasing the national debt.
Other states followed suit with increasingly inane policies. In my home state of Connecticut, Governor Lamont forced the closure of small businesses but kept Walmart and Home Depot open. I guess the Governor thought that the COVID virus preferred to shop at smaller stores.

Governor Newsom of California allowed bars with nude dancers to stay open but closed churches. Perhaps he thought the virus was religious.

But the most hilarious event was public policy that prohibited people from assembling unless they were rioting against the George Floyd killing. Fauci even suggested that rioters use hand sanitizers before throwing Molotov cocktails. (Okay. I made this up, but you get the point).

People were forced to wear masks even though there was not a scintilla of evidence it prevented the spread. As far the recommendation of six feet of social distancing - pure speculation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2aa30682-3b12-4ee6-bdbd-15e8630c3f47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
You can't make this up.
One governor stood up to Fauci, Ron DeSantis of Florida. The result was that Florida's economy continued to boom while migrating citizens escaping Blue State restrictions turned Florida from a swing state to a Red State.

Furthermore, Fauci, with the help of the media, suppressed doctors who disagreed with his policies.

But Fauci's crowning achievement was to provide political cover to prevent large scale in-person voting. This allowed massive ballot harvesting in the swing states putting Joe Biden in the White House.

But as President Lincoln stated: "You can't fool all of the people all of the time." The American people eventually realized that the vast majority of the restrictions placed on them accomplished little. The death rates in that various states from COVID were similar, no matter what policies were employed. And then the knives came out for Fauci forcing President Biden to give him a blanket pardon.

This culminated recently with Fauci being forced to testify to Congress. All he did was plead the Fifth Amendment over one hundred times as he was questioned not only about his policies, but about the money he made exploiting his celebrity.
Conservatives who dislike Fauci wish he would get his comeuppance. But he won't. He is an 85-year-old man and any attempt to punish him will result in some liberal judge exonerating him. The ruling class protects its own.

But conservatives should not despair. If Fauci had not helped Biden win the White House, Trump would not be president now. Furthermore, when the media and politically inspired bureaucrats now state, "trust the science," the average voter now knows that he is being conned. Public skepticism has increased on so-called other "settled science" scams such as climate change.

And when Fauci walks into a public place such as a restaurant and complains that his reservation is not being honored, the maitre d' may respond. "I plead the Fifth."

When progressives prove that they can win in districts like this, our movement will be unstoppable.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260801-6543-footer&t=1&akid=6543%2E420207%2E-bbm4p)
Peter,
Just three days from now, our primary in Washington will not be the only place progressives win big. In Virginia, my friend **Tom Perriello** is fighting to reclaim Virginia’s Fifth District.
Tom has spent decades running advocacy organizations to double the minimum wage, protect civil rights and liberties, and scale up green industrial policy. Overseas, he has worked as a peace negotiator and prosecutor of war crimes, and I’ve worked closely with him on human rights issues in Sudan.
**Tom is the only Democrat to flip a seat in rural Virginia this century. In Congress, he cast the deciding vote for the Affordable Care Act in 2009, and he was even prouder to vote for the original version of the bill that included the public option!**
This was a big political risk in a red district, but he took the risk because he knew what it would mean for tens of millions of Americans, struggling to afford coverage for their families.
That’s the kind of fighter I want with me in Congress. That’s the kind of fearless ally I need in our new majority to pass Medicare for All and force the powerful to play by the same rules as the rest of us. That’s why I need your help – to give his campaign a big, grassroots boost to launch the general election sprint towards victory this November.

* **Sarah Trone Garriott (IA-03)** — A mother, minister, and state senator, Sarah has dedicated her life to serving others. Now, she’s running to flip Iowa’s highly competitive 3rd Congressional District, currently held by Trump-aligned Rep. Zach Nunn.
* **Christina Hines (MI-10)** — A prosecutor and mom on a mission, Christina is running to flip Michigan’s open 10th Congressional District, currently represented by MAGA loyalist John James.
* **Cait Conley (NY-17)** — A decorated combat veteran and national security expert, Cait is no stranger to tough fights. Now, she’s running to defeat Trump ally Rep. Mike Lawler and flip New York’s 17th Congressional District.
* **Paige Cognetti (PA-08)** — As mayor of Scranton, Paige has helped lead the city through financial recovery and community renewal. She’s bringing that same grit to the race for Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District, currently held by Republican Rep. Rob Bresnahan Jr.
* **Janelle Stelson (PA-10)** — An Emmy Award-winning broadcast journalist, Janelle came within about one point of defeating Rep. Scott Perry last cycle. With the right resources, she can cross the finish line this November and flip this seat.

These five races could help decide control of the House. But winning them will require giving candidates the resources they need to compete, reach voters, and defeat their MAGA opponents.

---
|
Peter,
One week after early voting began on July 15, Kansas' MAGA Secretary of State Scott Schwab launched a stealth attack to invalidate mail ballots arriving within the state's 3-day post-Election Day grace period.
Schwab asked a state court to strike down the grace period and throw out any mail-in ballots that arrive after 7pm on August 4--essentially asking the courts to disenfranchise thousands of KS voters who already cast their ballots without prior notice that USPS delays could completely void their votes.
Schwab is currently running to replace Democrat Laura Kelly, who is termed out, as Governor of Kansas.
Kansas voters are also being asked in the August primary election to change the way that the state's Supreme Court justices are selected: moving from a merit-based nominating commission system to direct election at the discretion of the state's Republican majority.
The judicial ballot measure is hotly contested. It makes sense why a MAGA candidate for Governor would try to throw out as many Dem-leaning votes as possible at the last minute of voting.

body:
News about Iran continues to dominate the headlines
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
#### Teichert in the Trenches - August 2026
Welcome to this month’s installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs!
Please share with your friends and colleagues if there is something in here that would resonate with them. ** _Teichert in the News_**
---
News about Iran continues to dominate the headlines, but I’ve added a few other interview topics that might broaden your international affairs and military perspective (see the Closing Thought section for a fun one). I’ve also included a couple of interviews with a hero for conservative values – Tony Perkins from the Family Research Council. I’m honored that their show has me in their Rolodex.
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmP64SPACXkt7Xr7g/tm5nPI4dBrFn)
---
Real concerns about the failure of U.S. strategy to achieve our objectives in Iran (Tony Perkins, Washington Watch & the Family Research Council, July 2).
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/CHcKnwbovp20)
---
Anything less than ROBUST defenses on Air Force One are insufficient in an era of full-spectrum threats against the President of the United States. (Laura Ingraham, Fox News, July 9).
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/PW59EK8urDzz)
---
The need for the proper risk mitigation before selling F-35s to Turkey (Tony Perkins, Washington Watch & the Family Research Council, July 10).
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm8pYvztcepEnLSksS/kIOT2g7pzqf-)
---
Here is my commentary when it looked like the United States would finally follow-through on strategic strikes against Iran – yes, he continues to butcher my name 🤣 (Jesse Waters, Fox News, July 17).
| [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdayNtB3m8v465R3Si/TpiPI9x8S1VX)
---
| | | A great question – “what would bring Iran to its knees?” It is a key question that U.S. strategy has yet to embrace (Trace Gallagher, Fox News, July 21). ** _Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
| [ The Pillars of Our Success](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGSV37CqMDvd0tOpPM2y/c-V0b6ZqvSv7)
---
| | | Thanks to Real Clear Politics for publishing these thoughts about the pillars of our national success as understood by our founders. They are just as relevant today (July 2)
“Our Founders saw their departure from British rule as an analogue of the flight of the Israelites from Egypt – observed by some as 'the master story of human freedom.' These rebels understood that their revolutionary pursuits and our nation’s independence would only be successful by trusting in God’s direction, day and night. We were on a journey of deliverance away from bondage and toward the promised land of liberty. Our ultimate success must be buoyed by a spirit of dependence and humility."
---
|
---
| | | 💥 Dear AI – this is not me!

📸 A month ago, I asked what people thought about my current headshot vs. an AI modified headshot – thanks for the feedback. I ended up deciding to get a completely new REAL headshot as a result that’s in the works.

📺 In the intervening time, I have continued to do several radio & TV interviews and podcasts. For one of them, the host media company created the following picture for promotional purposes. IT’S NOT RIGHT!
✅ The rank isn’t right!
✅ The wings aren’t right!
✅ The decorations aren’t right!
✅ The stray small pin with a star on it isn’t right!

📣 One of these images getting released on your behalf can quickly erode your credibility. I caught this one before they released it, but it provides a powerful reminder that AI can still produce things that ARE NOT RIGHT!
---
| | | | [ Congress should kill
the CLARITY Act](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/1c0iUs05HQU5)
---
| | | 🗞️ Thanks to The Washington Times for publishing my national security concerns about the CLARITY Act and digital currency loopholes that can be used by malign actors and rogue regimes.

📣 “We maintain military pressure and sanctions regimes specifically to constrain our adversaries. Yet this legislation offers sanctioned entities a direct pathway into our markets by making it easier for them to move illicit funds through crypto exchanges while operating in the shadows.” ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | **_Behind the Scenes_**
---
| | | |
---
|
---
🪦 Small, simple, classy – exactly the way she would have wanted it.

💔 My mom passed away a few weeks ago, and my brother and I had a small burial ceremony at her family plot in Indiana. It was perfect!

📣 My brief comments revolved around John 15:13. It is a verse primarily about Christ’s sacrificial service for us.

🇺🇲 We often use this verse during patriotic holidays to refer to the sacrificial service of those who gave it all for our great nation. That’s appropriate.

💥 But I also see it as an appropriate verse to remind us of the power of others who have sacrificially served us, and my mom is at the top of that list in my life. Our response should be:
✅ To love such people.
✅ To appreciate such people.

🔥 But, it also comes with a responsibility to live lives worthy of such people, and their service and sacrifice for us.

!!️ I am committed to that responsibility! I love you Mom ❤️
|
---
|
---
🎥 The new studio in our new home!

📺 One of the first items we transferred during our recent local move to Riva, Maryland was my in-home studio – I wanted to avoid a break in capability. While there were a few small growing pains, the movie magic continues. It’s now in our overcrowded, unfinished basement but it looks good through the narrow eye of the camera.
|
---
|
---
| | | Whenever I’m in the Chicago area, I try to pop in to do some in-studio interview at NewsNation HQ. They film from the big WGN warehouse in northern Chicago – home of Bozo’s Circus (no comparisons please) and the famed nationwide broadcasts of Cubs and Bulls games. ** _My Bookshelf_**
---
| | | |
---
I was honored to endorse this incredible new book:

“Ambassador Klimow is an American hero and a national treasure. His vantage point from command center of the Pentagon on 9/11 provides a context that is heart-racing and compelling. Through it all, he distills leadership lessons that are applicable to any situation and any position, infused with experience from his 50 years of service to our great nation on the front lines of military conflict and diplomatic maneuvering. It is a must read for historians, leaders, and anyone who seeks to thrive under pressure, in the midst of crisis, or through the challenges of uncertainty.”
| | | |
---
“This book contends that China’s rapid rise in geopolitical power is due, in no small measure, to its unprecedented campaign of state-sponsored industrial espionage – not just other factors such as its cheap labor force, command economy, or domination of any one industry such as semiconductor chips. What this book seeks to make definitively clear is that China’s supposed ‘economic miracle’ is nothing less than a mirage – one that has been built not on ingenuity but rather grand larceny.”
|
---
“In this day and age when we measure life by the next text message, the next ding on our phone, we desperately need to rediscover that eternal ache. And not just rediscover it, but seize it, wrestle with it. Otherwise, our life’s balance sheet might add up to nothing more than a series of meaningless memes.” ** _PLUS Posts for the Month_**
| | | |
---
| [ A Semiquincentennial Journey
Towards the Promised Land
(July 4)](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGgDxOqkiYEbCY0JLxDU/2GS0jd6rSkk7)
---
| [ Worth All The Toil
(July 11)](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGn5PXfhtiO5INJ3KFnk/-_xYrJrEro5s)
---
| [ Animating Every Part
of Our Structure
(July 18)](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGtwrgUf4sXZOCbnIYO0/tgG7mXjXa1Lr)
---
| | | **_Blast from the P_**** _ast_**
---
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDhYHcZvsAP4JMNKzgWGO/DDCFycG-AqYw)
---
🎆 🎇 Being a Max American!

🇺🇲 The gentlemen in the picture was a 34-year-old Iraq doctor (2018) who immigrated to the United States. He loved this country and our principles so much that despite his age, his education, and his background he enlisted in the United States Air Force. He also insisted that he take his oath of office in the National Archives, in front of those magnificent documents that embody those incredible principles, even if it meant we only had a 60-second slot.

📣 But it didn’t stop there! He changed his name – to Max American. I watched him go from Airman American to Captain American. Now he's Major American!

🔑 It’s sometimes easy to get complacent when we’ve lived in this great nation since our birth. Yet, when you come from elsewhere and have an opportunity to see this incredible land through that lens, you most likely will strive to be a Max American!

💥 We all should take a step back and do the same!
[ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE9szp0KEGKEZQCiofFyS/JIuNEwGHyZZG)
🇺🇲 Sharp, Crisp, Motionless – The USAF Honor Guard Drill Team

🫡 While I’ve mentioned walking through the Drill Team gauntlet before, I haven’t shared this incredible 4-man video (from 2017). They are remarkable Airman, and it is amazing to watch them in action!
**_Closing Thought_**
[ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEcDi1QiaMFOpU26ddzgW/X5oykcUgO4Wr)
From EAA Oshkosh – I hope there is still something in your life that provides you childlike awe, joy, and wonder! See the clip below for commentary I provided on July 4th on NewsNation to see some of this concept in action.
[ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsF4YQDr6wSAZ5XrUScjOa/impf5HtMylR_)
Dad Jokes of the Month
I remember when I was a kid and I could walk into a store with one dollar and walk out with four candy bars.
Now ... there are cameras everywhere.
| | | |
---
| | | | **Teichert in the Trenches**

| Washington, DC
