name: Team Voter Action Project
subject: Rejecting Trump's USPS Board nominees
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Team,
Donald Trump recently nominated four candidates for the USPS Board of Governors in an attempted takeover of the cherished public institution that is older than the nation itself. And he knows good and well USPS is responsible for carrying millions of ballots during the midterm elections.
The Postal Board controls the policy decisions, financials, service standards, and long-term direction of USPS. It also has sole hire and fire power over the Postmaster General.
Our coalition made enough noise that two of the nominees never made it to a vote , but the other two – Jeffrey Brodsky and William Gallo – were just voted out of committee and the entire Senate could soon vote to confirm or reject them.
This is our last chance to stop Trump from dominating the postal board and being able to bully a giant step forward on his election interference schemes, as well as everything from price hikes and delivery slowdowns to privatization.
Demand the Senate reject these disastrous nominees while we still can >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Rural communities, Indigenous communities, seniors, veterans, small businesses, postal workers, and voters shouldn’t pay the price while private shipping corporations claim the profitable pieces. But that's exactly what these guys want.
Brodsky has spent 30 years in the corporate restructuring world, treating distressed companies as projects to be cut apart, reorganized, and squeezed for investors — a literal privatization expert. Gallo comes from commodities trading and private business. Neither one has any postal experience or much less a record of defending universal service, postal workers, affordable rates, rural delivery, or election mail.
We have no reason to believe anything other than these corporate stooges are ready and willing to do whatever Trump wants regardless of the impact on one of the most trusted, effective, and respected public services in the country.
A Trump-dominated board will almost certainly weaken protections for election mail , putting vote by mail at risk for the midterms and beyond.
Trump wants a Postal Service that follows his political orders and prepares itself for a corporate sell-off. The Senate can stop him. Send your letter right now! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-postal-board-takeover/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

name: Raja
subject: They chanted "Death to Krishnamoorthi"
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.
Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.
A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.
I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.
Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.
A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.
And every single time, I have made the same choice.
Keep going.
Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.
This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.
Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch . Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.
Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.
Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect leaders who won't be intimidated — no matter what they face? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
They can scream all they want.
We are not slowing down.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now

Peter,

**NEW YORK CITY HAS FALLEN, DAY OF MAMDANI!!**

We are in a political race for results now. I hope the Republican Party and MAGA movement can hear me on this. The stewards of capitalism must find a financial remedy to our current situation, through innovation and a commitment to sacred honor, before the nihilism and cynicism of Socialism take root. The "free market" and "free trade" must be modified for the times.

**THIS IS THE RED ALERT!** Mamdani is only the beginning. We must remain the party and movement of the working class.

| [ **FIGHT BACK AGAINST COMMUNISM** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=fd0b322055554f4c9adf9ff9632f04b3&_e=Qi4eKefJcJiAeX0_eise3R51lEiFDku_47pN1DNIxl5SssnR8iBejBxaqzMLA4xrTJQc27TX3AuGwJMSGJqCQbPueGTYjqv15bPJsWQrNUM1rQDs4A_DujRhI3jLg-V0UX09xKZkpIQVCYijcb-8sgExH6lBf1WeX9S6iC7jF_IROsU5nuHZCTyU--RkuEZv3-OdsSAPH-Ib-1CZcKRWkOHIvGWX08pP52-zjOnOuf1VglDuV8XsOhoEm-0DiJX96NY_sE57VFakxwtlFfIchXxboipGDuHDNXVrtwRQZILPZEzJsBJM44eiBMiBrlacTAoe-6EDnEG6C8I-jbZWpLDfKB2imubmlQ_zkSzfzWlviSTM0zg36SOQOM99n1YWZsnV57LiSh_yB4uG7mrj5iR6XAkVNVMbasApar1wgRqJYnOH7blfM0XsGTNonlXh7tsQB-_VQ9GOIOaYQTXtX2-jqNA0B7exVQ7ugBjOBCANG06oqKwPg-KdVvwKoKvyZq34gfFv5fCmWlMEIeAmqdQ-n2iMzEUF7Igp0NC-nxI-noO7Eh1AOXQBBX2Bp4MR)
---

We need to deregulate, reduce taxes on the working class, and, most importantly, enforce our antitrust laws. The monopolization in America is out of control, and the monopolization of finance is abhorrent. The problem is that politicians can't say that and hope to win because the control of money controls our elections, most of the time. At this point, if we try to hold onto this way, we will have to do it by force, and inevitably, that will become destabilizing itself.

What has staved off communism in America, in the past, was the cultural belief in socioeconomic mobility. The social piece is all but blown as everyone believes they're the star in their own movie now. Everybody believes they're more important than they actually are. Which has created an inverse epidemic of self-doubt and self-hatred. The economic mobility piece must be restored. But artificial intelligence and socialism won't do it. People have to be motivated and incentivized to get better, at a craft, a passion, a job, a skill...

_If those things become invaluable, we will have an even bigger existential crisis. Who are we even as humankind?_

Still, we cannot continue to pretend like the game hasn't been rigged. It disappoints me that more Republicans don't listen to Steve Bannon when he says we have to find a way to spread this wealth around... Yes, we detest communists because we can see when and where they have waved their flag in history, genocide follows.

**The uncomfortable truth about America is at our core, we have already become a communist nation.** When we print money, bail out the failures of the rich, and socialize the risk, we have undermined capitalism and meritocracy. If your society is built on money and you socialize the money, you're a communist nation. We have to turn back now. This has to become the beating heart of the MAGA movement. We must hold the principle and move people toward the principle.

**Convenience will be the death of freedom.** If you trade your freedom for security, you deserve neither, and you will have neither. This is true for the security of basic necessities or food and welfare, as well as the security of a military-industrial complex and dollar empire.

_**THIS IS WHY THEY FEAR ME, on both sides of the aisle.**_

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

subject: I grew up in a working-class family
body:

Peter,
I grew up in a working-class family in Allagash.
We didn’t always have heat or running water. Sometimes, we relied on food assistance to make ends meet.
My dad was a logger out in the woods, and one day he and his fellow loggers had to stand up to a wealthy landowner who was threatening their wages. They weren’t even asking for more money, they just wanted to be paid fairly.
“Take the pay cut or go home,” they were told.
I’ll never forget that day. I was only 11 years old, and watched my dad fight for something bigger than all of us — a basic fairness every worker should be entitled to, the ability to make ends meet, the ability to put food on the table for their family.
I know what it’s like to worry about paying the bills on time. I know what it’s like to fight, not just for your own future, but for the future of everyone around you, too.
And it’s that fight I’ll bring to the United States Senate. For too long, our voices have been ignored and crushed by powerful corporations and special interests who make backroom deals with greedy politicians.
Now’s our chance to change that. Peter, we have less than 100 days to build a campaign big enough to defeat Susan Collins. But with your help today, I know we can do it. I promise you I’ll spend every day in the Senate fighting for you and your families.
So that’s why I have to ask: can you chip in a donation of any amount split between my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now to defeat Collins and take back our Democratic majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-jackson?amount=25]

Peter,

If I’ve learned one thing from coaching, it is this: _**you don't take a bye week when you haven't earned one.**_

That's exactly why I’m standing with Mike Lee. We can always agree on common sense.

I’m joining Mike Lee in objecting to recessing the Senate until we pass the SAVE America Act. It’s a no-brainer. I’m voting against any recess until this bill gets a vote — because to me, this isn't complicated. It's the two-minute drill, and we're the ones burning the clock.

The Senate hasn't even funded the military. We're staring down a shutdown. Our elections STILL aren't secure. That's not a team that's earned five weeks off.

Rick Scott, Ashley Moody, Jim Banks, Bill Hagerty, and Darline Graham have joined us. President Trump is telling the Senate to stay in D.C and get it done, too.

| [ **JOIN US >>** ](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=1f0ca73852ad4830911b72e4f289e21c&_e=TvGyABlQfvOMllqMBn-EvXVbLRciPtX7tJOnxG863I7m1QN7Bnt9Juair6lTW_2fbIDQnpfHIe8tgD5eagB8XoIqodeUUksyVYjr1fOK06obFjlKnaYG69TKZXjrAz9mMda-vc7BYcaRmhdAOThiLZ6szTbFcpJrKBVH8duiX-E9iXDH2CHCkBU4j8DOhScfsXQAihfu6p3eqP0718s1QROPJWKaaq-3OAmOosvvsoO2bUvX5KWUyHp2BLK8s8Cr-9q2QQvjeUTEbqvnNehJOGl8VcOiiamCAhl7GLNUet3JQFwkzaVHNfZoEeZ6HcS1fWYRAcpYAj2Ux0k_oZQZ_cy0yXVniX47JtmPmllce9565_AtIE3ehQxiLi6jxLEPMUD-hMTv-7WoPWtezqIKIklD04e4gOgx45SUobusRwtcnFN5-VkAcEOES8FSWmwyDMeNuKWLUb6d0fVkihhnTRIPZ4x9ThPf8svoEejZUG1jVKN3xxYDPpyJhEULALCZDHLj_kdyhmwETTwvJxFBN7Mrl2JZjIRY0J0oz8kPBc5rVz8ZWBXmZHb0F0THCubB)
---

15 million people crossed our border illegally under Biden and Obama. And you can bet they're being counted on to vote in the midterms. _**If we don't pass this bill first, we're not losing an election — we're handing them the keys to steal the next two.**_

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

body:
No more closed door deals

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fc0ffbdf6278/vern-calls-for-data-center-moratorium?e=37dda778f5)

[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Oiyzs1156Sw?e=37dda778f5&c2id=cdbf6368064ed4acbe3dc3fec7c073dc)
| | | | | |

**It's Time to Hit Pause on Data Centers**
North Dakota has seen a wave of large-scale data center projects over the past two years, with more on the way — and most of it is happening behind closed doors.These deals get cut with little public notice, and local officials are often asked to sign non-disclosure agreements just to sit at the table. Once the deals are signed, North Dakotans are often the last to find out what was promised — how much water and land a project will use, what happens if it falls through, or what our own elected officials agreed to on our behalf.That's why I'm calling for two things: a **one-year moratorium on new large-scale data** center approvals in North Dakota, and a **ban on public officials signing NDAs** with these companies. Not a permanent stop — a pause. Twelve months to put real disclosure and accountability rules on the books, so the public can see the terms and the fine print before more of these deals get locked in for good.
---
| [Donate](https://us.list-manage.com/IGRDUnhQtKl?e=37dda778f5&c2id=cdbf6368064ed4acbe3dc3fec7c073dc)
---
| | This is exactly the kind of Wild West development our regulators are supposed to get ahead of, not chase after. Farmers and ranchers are already paying more and earning less. They shouldn't have to find out after the fact what's been signed away in their name — by officials who signed away their own voice in the process too.
The Agriculture Commissioner's job is to stand up for the people working the land — not wave projects through behind closed doors and hope it works out. **Learn more, visit our**[**Data Center Resources webpage- >**](https://us.list-manage.com/cxaPH4ymkfO?e=37dda778f5&c2id=cdbf6368064ed4acbe3dc3fec7c073dc)

I have a lot of thoughts about Donald Trump and his speech. But I’ve been thinking about this one the most:
Here in Pennsylvania, we solve problems. We bring folks together. We get stuff done for everyone who calls our Commonwealth home.
**We should expect the same from the President of the United States — and from his handpicked Republican nominee for Governor.**

subject: Friend, Alice was taken, but she was found
body:
She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e12579088/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVVdBSldFV2J2bg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MDE/LbmNsZEFCdXZlUQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNZbHFTakJkSG5LNERscw/gam5xqw/s9sd0a25bef)
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. **Her name is Alice.**
---
[ Rescue A Child Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And this is the part most people never hear. **She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker’s username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI.** Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker’s **IP address**. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. **Alive.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Her trafficker now faces **20 years to life** in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking.
This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting.
Still trapped.
---
[ Rescue A Child Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
And that is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation’s** mission is clear: **_To stop the sale of God’s children._** The foundation extends the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: **_A world where every child is safe and free._** We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching ** _Operation Search and Rescue,_** a __ mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence.

We will support real rescue operations using tools like **digital tracking and face recognition**. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped.
And today, you can be part of it. **And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.** **A concerned Child Defense Organization** **has approved** **a** **$10,000 MATCHING GRANT**.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Every dollar you give will be **doubled**. **$25 Gift Doubles to $50**
**$50 Gift Doubles to $100**
**$100 Gift Doubles to $200**
**$250 Gift Doubles to $500**
**$500 Gift Doubles to $1,000** Your gift goes twice as far to help find and rescue children. **This is God multiplying love.** [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[Your donation of $25, $50, $100 or whatever you can give today can have twice the impact, and double the chance to bring a child home.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**
---
[ Double My Impact Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Jesus said, _“Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me.”_(Matthew 18:5) **Today you can be that welcome.**
**You can enable the search and help the rescue mission to bring a child home.** Please give as generously as you can while your gift is matched. And please pray for Alice, and for the children still waiting.
And for the day when every child is safe and free. **Because**** _God’s children are not for sale._** With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
---

name: Roy Cooper
subject: This is the race experts say will decide U.S. Senate control
body:
We need to kick things off in the strongest position possible, win in North Carolina, and return power to the people.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&source=&t=1&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
| | | | It’s go time, Peter.
---
The GOP is already attacking our campaign. They’re lying about my record here in North Carolina. They’re spending millions of dollars to try to defeat me. **Unless we fight back now, we will be at a huge disadvantage.**
[**_This is predicted to be the most expensive Senate race in history, so will you chip in $5 monthly between now and Election Day to help us win in North Carolina and return power to the people?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17620?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&amount=5&t=15&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
_Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue._ | | | [DONATE $5 MONTHLY](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17387?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&amount=5&t=16&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
---
| | [DONATE $10 MONTHLY](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17387?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&amount=10&t=17&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
---
| | [DONATE $25 MONTHLY](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17387?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&amount=25&t=18&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
---
| | [DONATE ANOTHER
AMOUNT MONTHLY](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17387?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&t=19&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
---
I am ready to stand up to the far right’s chaos and corruption in Washington. And unlike my Republican opponent, I will never stop fighting for lower prices, affordable health care, abortion access, voting rights and good schools.
Trump and the GOP know this – and they know that if we win here, Democrats can retake control of the Senate and block their harmful agenda. Now that we’re less than 100 days from the election, far-right Republicans will pour even more millions into our race to prevent that from happening.
**While I’ve never lost an election, I need the support of people like you to win again. We cannot run the risk of Trump’s handpicked candidate getting to the U.S. Senate and helping the GOP hold on to power any longer.**
[**_Please make a monthly contribution of $5 or any amount that is meaningful to you to help us fight back against the GOP. We must come together to face what’s ahead, flip this seat from red to blue and take back the Senate for the people._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/17620?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&amount=5&t=20&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
I’m grateful to have you on this team. Thank you.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk826_mra&t=2&akid=2416%2E124072%2EyKqD8y)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: She lied to your face.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Peter,
Earlier this week, on a debate stage with thousands of Michiganders watching, my opponent lied to you.
I don't say that lightly. A moderator asked Haley Stevens a direct question: has she taken money from DTE Energy — the utility that left hundreds of thousands of Michiganders without power this summer? She said **no.**
**The receipts say otherwise.** Haley Stevens _did_ take money from DTE Energy, over $47,000 of it. Reporters quickly fact-checked her:
[](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260801-3-ak.-TIUmm&amount=5&refcode=em20260801-2796&t=2&akid=2796%2E251025%2EZopulT)
That wasn't the only place her story didn't match the record either, Peter.
**She says she's tough on ICE. Her voting record says otherwise.** She's voted to fund ICE. She voted for a resolution thanking ICE agents "for protecting the homeland" — the same ICE that's been tearing through our neighborhoods.
She claimed to be focused on investing our tax dollars here in Michigan, but a few weeks ago, **she broke with the majority of House Democrats to vote in favor of sending $3.3 billion in unconditional military aid to Israel** — money that could've gone toward lowering your power bill or fixing the grid that just failed you.
Peter, we've watched MAGA Republicans build an entire playbook out of lying to people's faces and hoping they won't check. I'm not going to let my opponent use that same playbook to deceive her way to the Democratic nomination and put this must-win Senate seat at risk.
But I can’t take on this fight alone. AIPAC’s Super PACs and corporate PACs have spent $61+ million to prop up our opponent and stop us, and the only way we’ll overcome that level of spending is if we stick together. **Please stand with me and chip in $5 so we can make sure Michiganders know the facts before they cast their ballot:**
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20260801-3-ak](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260801-3-ak.-TIUmm&amount=5&refcode=em20260801-2796&t=3&akid=2796%2E251025%2EZopulT)**
In solidarity,
Abdul
